messages:
maria: heads up — multiple customers reporting p99 latency ~3x on hosted text-generation endpoints for redwood-13b-v2-q8 since last runtime deploy (~14:10 UTC). Region: us-west-2. Error rates are normal but tail latency is bad. any kernel/compile changes rolled recently?

oliver: saw alerts in grafana. p95 up ~40%, p99 up ~220% on gpu-pool-a. Spike aligns with runtime rollout v1.12.3. suspect kernel selector flip to FlashAttention for long sequences.

deploy-bot: rollout redwood-runtime-kernel v1.12.3 completed to us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T14:10Z (sha: abcdef123).

sana: i can repro locally against hosted endpoint with seq_len=2048 + batch=1. baseline (sdpa) avg p99 ~0.6s, after v1.12.3 p99 ~2.1s. quick repro: 
```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-v2-q8","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -r .id
```
logs show repeated fallback warnings and kernel mismatch hints: 
```
[warn] kernel_selector: chosen=flash_attn_q8, fallback=sdpa at step 1 seq=2048
[error] flash_kernel: qkv_reorder_mismatch detected, using slow-path
```

ekaterina: thanks. i pulled runtime logs — compile flags for the flash build included `-mflash=true -march=sm80` (ampere). Looks like the flash kernel path is triggering a slow-path for q8 quantized ops when seq_len > 1024. we previously saw similar behavior with a different model but it was caught by canary.

ekaterina: quick mitigation options: 1) flip kernel priority for redwood-13b-v2-q8 to prefer sdpa over flash in selector (canary 10%) 2) revert the flash kernel rollout for us-west-2 3) adjust compile flags and rebuild (longer). recommend (1) + (3) as follow-up.

maria: agreed. jay, can you apply a selector hotpatch to send 10% of traffic back to sdpa for this model in us-west-2 and monitor p99 for 15m? also open a support note to affected customers. i'll draft a status blurb. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jay: on it. applying model-level override now. command i used: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-13b-v2-q8","region":"us-west-2","kernel_selector_override":{"priority":["sdpa","flash"]},"traffic_allocation":0.1}
```

jay: update — override applied to 10% of traffic at 14:36 UTC. starting canary monitoring (p99 window=5m).

support-bot: created support ticket #CS-4721, notified customers in affected orgs with initial context and ETA for mitigation.

oliver: preliminary metrics: canary 10% shows p99 back to ~0.65s, rest of cluster remains high. that's encouraging. if stable over 15m, we should increase to 50% then full.

ekaterina: i'll also open a kernel rebuild ticket to remove the problematic compile flag and run microbenchmarks for q8 long sequences. tagging runtime-kerneleads.

maria: plan: (A) increase canary to 50% at 14:52 if p99 holds for 15m (jay) (B) notify infra to pause further flash kernel rollouts (oliver) (C) create postmortem task to track root cause + fix (ekaterina). i'll post a short customer-facing note after the 50% check. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jay: 14:52 — increased override to 50%. monitoring...

oliver: i've paused the automated kernel rollout pipeline for us-west-2. will coordinate with ci/cd to block v1.12.3 until rebuild.

maria: follow-up actions: CS ticket updated, postmortem assigned to ekaterina, rollback plan if canary degrades. closing loop here once we hit full rollback or rebuild.

support-bot: CS-4721 updated: mitigation applied (kernel selector override), customers informed, ETA for permanent fix: 72 hours.

maria: thanks team. we'll reconvene in #eng-runtime after postmortem draft.
